title: MASTERS ATTP – the tournament of the elite!
body_html:
On 22 March, the wide and honest community of table tennis players witnessed the most prestigious and grandest table tennis tournament in the Republic of Moldova, held at the country’s best table tennis arena — MASTERS ATTP 2025.

MASTERS ATTP is a shining symbol of skill, willpower and the pursuit of perfection, bringing together the country’s best players year after year. We are proud that a tournament of this scale can be staged in the Republic of Moldova too, and that it has become an essential part of the national sporting culture.

MASTERS ATTP is about the best athletes and examples of determination, discipline and courage. Every one of them is a winner, because table tennis is not just a game but a philosophy built on a constant desire to learn and grow.

Table tennis is more than a sport — it is a school of life. It teaches us to fight for our dreams, to act as a team and to push past our own limits.

MASTERS ATTP is about tense moments that turned into real sporting dramas and positive emotions that left an indelible mark on the hearts of players and spectators alike.

Congratulations to all the participants for the enthusiasm and energy they brought to this tournament. Their performances at the table inspire thousands of people across the country, and their skill will serve as an example for future generations of players. And of course, we must mention the finalists, the prize-winners and the champion.

1st place, Master of Sport Denis ȚERNA

2nd place, Master of Sport Veniamin DUBROVIN

3rd place, Master of Sport Igor NI

4th place, Master of Sport Oleg DOBRJINSCHI

5th place, Master of Sport Danila TITOV

6th place, Candidate Master of Sport Daniel BELIBOV

Their efforts, perseverance and desire to be the best are what made them true champions!

Coming soon…!
